[[File:Elspeth Jellison 2020 Endor Grand Prix.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Elspeth Jellison at the [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]].]]
'''Elspeth Jellison''' and [[Ryan Jellison]] won the team tournament at the [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]].<ref name="wrap2020egp">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/congrats-to-hayes-hunter-2020-egp-champion/ Congrats to Hayes Hunter, 2020 EGP Champion!], starwarsccg.org (27 January 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201129051103/https://www.starwarsccg.org/congrats-to-hayes-hunter-2020-egp-champion/ Internet Archive]</ref> She finished 22nd in the main event.<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ 2020 Endor Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org</ref>
